bullets.title: These are some of my favorite answers to the question “If you could put anything on a huge billboard, what would it be?”, from profiles in Tools of Titans. “Don’t believe everything you think.” - BJ Miller (@zenhospice) This was BJ’s reminder that we shouldn’t take ourselves too seriously. “Talk less, listen more.” - Brené Brown (@brenebrown) Brené originally wanted to say “Shut up, and listen!”, but she joked that she didn’t want her kids reading that. The point was we need to ask more questions and better questions. “Don’t be an asshole.” - Rainn Wilson (@rainnwilson) Here’s Rainn’s explanation: “Because that would make the world a lot better place. Maybe someone driving along would be like, ‘Oh, you know what? Maybe I’m just gonna be not as much of an asshole today. I’m not gonna cut people off on the road and ignore my kids, backstab someone at work.” \--- Are you enjoying 5-Bullet Fridays?
